summary: A professionally designed cat café site with good branding but critical contrast issues and templated layout patterns.
criticalIssues: Severe contrast issues with white text on light pink backgrounds throughout the site
Navigation links are barely visible against the light pink header
Button text has poor contrast against background colors
Templated layout with predictable hero → features → CTA structure on every page
improvements: Add more visual interest with cat photography or illustrations
Create more distinctive section breaks with varied layouts
Enhance typography hierarchy with more size variation
Consider adding interactive elements for the adoption process

pageReviews.notes: Clean layout but excessive white space and contrast problems make text difficult to read; lacks visual engagement for a cat café
Well-organized content in two columns but follows predictable template structure; contrast issues persist with subheadings
Minimal content for such an important page; adoption journey visualization is too simplistic; needs more engaging presentation
Contact information is well-presented but the café interior placeholder image feels incomplete; good CTA prominence
